<description>
Part of #36692: This splits it into one test case per policy rule, each building its own transaction.

The `g_dust` and `g_bare_multi` globals are replaced by a `StandardPolicy` struct, which defaults to the node defaults and is passed to each check,  e.g. `CheckIsStandard(t, {.max_op_return_relay = 83})`, so no case changes policy for another.

No check is added or removed, and the expected reject reasons are the same. Since transactions are no longer carried over between checks, some values that are irrelevant to the rule under test differ from before.
</description>
